text: {"lessons":["My account rose early, then fell for several months, reminding me that short-term gains do not ensure lasting security; I should focus on protecting savings over the long term.","Selling appreciated shares locked in gains, but I should also review my overall stock exposure and keep enough cash for expenses rather than relying on a few winning trades.","I made no trades during the recent declines; I should avoid reacting to every monthly move, while still checking periodically that my holdings suit my need for stability."]}
